test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HOUSE' is written as 'FOSUC' and 'RAHUL' is written as 'PAUHJ'. How will 'ABOVE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HOUSE' is written as 'FOSUC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d5bea0ab0887ff975502d52041d7b0fdd17b7c658ce527e23e5f07b5bdbcb5f.png] 

'RAHUL' is written as 'PAUHJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4050352a48ac21b45e36af5ce7e75188fa4c140a412713a42d5537ecba80ee5f.png] 

Similarly, 'ABOVE' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8c24b24db682ad15e0784634df14ebe6314101a61e4d58a7e4790227cb53a18.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "YBVOC".**
